Offer seventy-five dollars per target share, entirely in buyer stock. What is full-year EPS, in dollars per share?

follow_up.question: Why can an all-stock acquisition be EPS-accretive without synergies?
follow_up.reference: The buyer may issue shares at a higher earnings multiple than the multiple paid for the target. EPS accretion from that arithmetic alone does not establish that the transaction creates economic value.
